15	package coralnpu
16	
17	import chisel3._
18	import chisel3.util._
19	import bus._
20	
21	/** AXI slave — routes host transactions to ITCM, DTCM or CoreAxiCSR.
22	  *
23	  * Address map (byte addresses on the AXI slave port):
24	  * {{{
25	  *   0x00000000 .. itcmSizeBytes-1  → ITCM back-door
26	  *   0x00010000 .. 0x10000+dtcm-1  → DTCM back-door
27	  *   0x00030000 .. 0x30000+0x200-1 → CSR (forwarded to CoreAxiCSR)
28	  * }}}
29	  *
30	  * The host AXI port is 128-bit wide.  ITCM/DTCM writes are forwarded as
31	  * 128-bit back-door writes; reads return 128-bit words.
32	  *
33	  * CSR transactions are routed transparently to the `csrAxi` port which
34	  * connects to a `CoreAxiCSR` instance in the parent module.
35	  */
36	class AxiSlave(p: Parameters) extends Module {
37	
38	  // Host-facing AXI is always 128-bit.
39	  private val axiBits  = 128
40	  val axiBytes = axiBits / 8
41	
42	  // Address boundaries
43	  val ITCM_BASE: Long = 0x00000000L
44	  private val DTCM_BASE: Long = 0x00010000L
45	  private val CSR_BASE:  Long = 0x00030000L
46	  private val CSR_SIZE:  Long = 0x00001000L
47	
48	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
49	    // Host AXI slave
50	    val axi    = Flipped(new AxiBundle(axiBits, p.addrBits, p.axiIdBits))
51	    // ITCM back-door (128-bit wide, word-addressed)
52	    val itcm = new Bundle {
53	      val en    = Output(Bool())
54	      val we    = Output(Bool())
55	      val addr  = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(p.itcmSizeBytes / axiBytes).W))
56	      val wdata = Output(UInt(axiBits.W))
57	      val wmask = Output(UInt(axiBytes.W))
58	      val rdata = Input(UInt(axiBits.W))
59	    }
60	    // DTCM back-door (128-bit wide, word-addressed)
61	    val dtcm = new Bundle {
62	      val en    = Output(Bool())
63	      val we    = Output(Bool())
64	      val addr  = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(p.dtcmSizeBytes / axiBytes).W))
65	      val wdata = Output(UInt(axiBits.W))
66	      val wmask = Output(UInt(axiBytes.W))
67	      val rdata = Input(UInt(axiBits.W))
68	    }
69	    // CSR AXI passthrough (forwarded to CoreAxiCSR)
70	    val csrAxi = new AxiBundle(axiBits, p.addrBits, p.axiIdBits)
71	  })
72	
73	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
74	  // Address decode helpers
75	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
76	  def inITCM(addr: UInt): Bool = addr < p.itcmSizeBytes.U
77	  def inDTCM(addr: UInt): Bool = (addr >= DTCM_BASE.U) && (addr < (DTCM_BASE + p.dtcmSizeBytes).U)
78	  def inCSR (addr: UInt): Bool = (addr >= CSR_BASE.U)  && (addr < (CSR_BASE  + CSR_SIZE).U)
79	
80	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
81	  // FSM
82	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
83	  object State extends ChiselEnum {
84	    val sIdle, sReadITCM, sReadITCMWait, sReadDTCM, sReadDTCMWait,
85	        sReadCSR, sReadCSRWait,
86	        sWriteITCM, sWriteDTCM, sWriteCSR,
87	        sReadResp, sWriteResp = Value
88	  }
89	  import State._
90	
91	  val state    = RegInit(sIdle)
92	  val idReg    = Reg(UInt(p.axiIdBits.W))
93	  val addrReg  = Reg(UInt(p.addrBits.W))
94	  val rdataReg = Reg(UInt(axiBits.W))
95	  val wdataReg = Reg(UInt(axiBits.W))
96	  val wmaskReg = Reg(UInt(axiBytes.W))
97	
98	  // Default drives
99	  io.itcm.en    := false.B
100	  io.itcm.we    := false.B
101	  io.itcm.addr  := addrReg(log2Ceil(p.itcmSizeBytes) - 1, log2Ceil(axiBytes))
102	  io.itcm.wdata := wdataReg
103	  io.itcm.wmask := wmaskReg
104	
105	  io.dtcm.en    := false.B
106	  io.dtcm.we    := false.B
107	  io.dtcm.addr  := (addrReg - DTCM_BASE.U)(log2Ceil(p.dtcmSizeBytes) - 1, log2Ceil(axiBytes))
108	  io.dtcm.wdata := wdataReg
109	  io.dtcm.wmask := wmaskReg
110	
111	  // CSR AXI: default tie-offs
112	  io.csrAxi.read.addr.valid       := false.B
113	  io.csrAxi.read.addr.bits.id    := idReg
114	  io.csrAxi.read.addr.bits.addr  := addrReg - CSR_BASE.U
115	  io.csrAxi.read.addr.bits.len   := 0.U
116	  io.csrAxi.read.addr.bits.size  := 2.U
117	  io.csrAxi.read.addr.bits.burst := 1.U
118	  io.csrAxi.read.data.ready      := false.B
119	  io.csrAxi.write.addr.valid      := false.B
120	  io.csrAxi.write.addr.bits.id   := idReg
121	  io.csrAxi.write.addr.bits.addr := addrReg - CSR_BASE.U
122	  io.csrAxi.write.addr.bits.len  := 0.U
123	  io.csrAxi.write.addr.bits.size := 2.U
124	  io.csrAxi.write.addr.bits.burst := 1.U
125	  io.csrAxi.write.data.valid      := false.B
126	  io.csrAxi.write.data.bits.data := wdataReg
127	  io.csrAxi.write.data.bits.strb := wmaskReg
128	  io.csrAxi.write.data.bits.last := true.B
129	  io.csrAxi.write.resp.ready     := false.B
130	
131	  // AXI slave default back-pressure
132	  io.axi.read.addr.ready  := (state === sIdle)
133	  io.axi.write.addr.ready := (state === sIdle)
134	  io.axi.write.data.ready := (state === sIdle)
135	
136	  io.axi.read.data.valid       := (state === sReadResp)
137	  io.axi.read.data.bits.id    := idReg
138	  io.axi.read.data.bits.data  := rdataReg
139	  io.axi.read.data.bits.resp  := 0.U
140	  io.axi.read.data.bits.last  := true.B
141	
142	  io.axi.write.resp.valid      := (state === sWriteResp)
143	  io.axi.write.resp.bits.id   := idReg
144	  io.axi.write.resp.bits.resp := 0.U
145	
146	  switch(state) {
147	    is(sIdle) {
148	      // ---- Read ----
149	      when(io.axi.read.addr.valid) {
150	        idReg   := io.axi.read.addr.bits.id
151	        addrReg := io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr
152	        state := MuxCase(sReadResp, Seq(
153	          inITCM(io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr) -> sReadITCM,
154	          inDTCM(io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr) -> sReadDTCM,
155	          inCSR (io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr) -> sReadCSR,
156	        ))
157	      }
158	      // ---- Write ----
159	      .elsewhen(io.axi.write.addr.valid && io.axi.write.data.valid) {
160	        idReg    := io.axi.write.addr.bits.id
161	        addrReg  := io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr
162	        wdataReg := io.axi.write.data.bits.data
163	        wmaskReg := io.axi.write.data.bits.strb
164	        state := MuxCase(sWriteResp, Seq(
165	          inITCM(io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr) -> sWriteITCM,
166	          inDTCM(io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr) -> sWriteDTCM,
167	          inCSR (io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr) -> sWriteCSR,
168	        ))
169	      }
170	    }
171	
172	    // ---- ITCM read --------------------------------------------------------
173	    // Cycle 0: assert enable; SRAM latches the address.
174	    is(sReadITCM) {
175	      io.itcm.en   := true.B
176	      io.itcm.we   := false.B
177	      io.itcm.addr := addrReg(log2Ceil(p.itcmSizeBytes) - 1, log2Ceil(axiBytes))
178	      state        := sReadITCMWait
179	    }
180	
181	    // Cycle 1: read data is now valid on io.itcm.rdata.
182	    is(sReadITCMWait) {
183	      rdataReg := io.itcm.rdata
184	      state    := sReadResp
185	    }
186	
187	    // ---- DTCM read --------------------------------------------------------
188	    // Cycle 0: assert enable; SRAM latches the address.
189	    is(sReadDTCM) {
190	      io.dtcm.en   := true.B
191	      io.dtcm.we   := false.B
192	      io.dtcm.addr := (addrReg - DTCM_BASE.U)(log2Ceil(p.dtcmSizeBytes) - 1, log2Ceil(axiBytes))
193	      state        := sReadDTCMWait
194	    }
195	
196	    // Cycle 1: read data is now valid on io.dtcm.rdata.
197	    is(sReadDTCMWait) {
198	      rdataReg := io.dtcm.rdata
199	      state    := sReadResp
200	    }
201	
202	    // ---- CSR read ---------------------------------------------------------
203	    // Present the AR beat; once accepted, wait for R beat from CoreAxiCSR.
204	    is(sReadCSR) {
205	      io.csrAxi.read.addr.valid      := true.B
206	      io.csrAxi.read.addr.bits.addr  := addrReg - CSR_BASE.U
207	      io.csrAxi.read.addr.bits.id    := idReg
208	      when(io.csrAxi.read.addr.ready) {
209	        state := sReadCSRWait
210	      }
211	    }
212	
213	    // Wait for the R beat from CoreAxiCSR, capture data, then send to host.
214	    is(sReadCSRWait) {
215	      io.csrAxi.read.data.ready := true.B
216	      when(io.csrAxi.read.data.valid) {
217	        rdataReg := io.csrAxi.read.data.bits.data
218	        state    := sReadResp
219	      }
220	    }
221	
222	    // ---- ITCM write -------------------------------------------------------
223	    is(sWriteITCM) {
224	      io.itcm.en    := true.B
225	      io.itcm.we    := true.B
226	      io.itcm.addr  := addrReg(log2Ceil(p.itcmSizeBytes) - 1, log2Ceil(axiBytes))
227	      io.itcm.wdata := wdataReg
228	      io.itcm.wmask := wmaskReg
229	      state         := sWriteResp
230	    }
231	
232	    // ---- DTCM write -------------------------------------------------------
233	    is(sWriteDTCM) {
234	      io.dtcm.en    := true.B
235	      io.dtcm.we    := true.B
236	      io.dtcm.addr  := (addrReg - DTCM_BASE.U)(log2Ceil(p.dtcmSizeBytes) - 1, log2Ceil(axiBytes))
237	      io.dtcm.wdata := wdataReg
238	      io.dtcm.wmask := wmaskReg
239	      state         := sWriteResp
240	    }
241	
242	    // ---- CSR write --------------------------------------------------------
243	    is(sWriteCSR) {
244	      io.csrAxi.write.addr.valid      := true.B
245	      io.csrAxi.write.addr.bits.addr  := addrReg - CSR_BASE.U
246	      io.csrAxi.write.addr.bits.id    := idReg
247	      io.csrAxi.write.data.valid      := true.B
248	      io.csrAxi.write.data.bits.data  := wdataReg
249	      io.csrAxi.write.data.bits.strb  := wmaskReg
250	      when(io.csrAxi.write.addr.ready && io.csrAxi.write.data.ready) {
251	        state := sWriteResp
252	      }
253	    }
254	
255	    // ---- Read response ----------------------------------------------------
256	    // rdataReg is populated by sReadITCMWait / sReadDTCMWait / sReadCSRWait.
257	    is(sReadResp) {
258	      io.axi.read.data.valid := true.B
259	      when(io.axi.read.data.ready) {
260	        state := sIdle
261	      }
262	    }
263	
264	    // ---- Write response ---------------------------------------------------
265	    is(sWriteResp) {
266	      // Relay CSR write response when applicable
267	      io.csrAxi.write.resp.ready := true.B
268	      io.axi.write.resp.valid    := true.B
269	      when(io.axi.write.resp.ready) {
270	        state := sIdle
271	      }
272	    }
273	  }
274	}
275

## Summary

The AxiSlave class in `/app/hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/AxiSlave.scala` does **not** reference `.prot`, `.lock`, `.cache`, `.qos`, or `.region` fields from the AXI address channel.

**Key findings:**

1. **No reference to those AXI fields**: The AxiSlave only accesses the following AXI address channel fields:
   - `.id` (line 150, 160)
   - `.addr` (line 151, 161)
   - For CSR passthrough: `.len`, `.size`, `.burst` (lines 115-117, 122-124)

2. **io.axi connections** (relevant excerpts):
   - **Read address channel** (lines 149-151):
     ```scala
     when(io.axi.read.addr.valid) {
       idReg   := io.axi.read.addr.bits.id
       addrReg := io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr
     ```
   
   - **Write address channel** (lines 160-161):
     ```scala
     idReg    := io.axi.write.addr.bits.id
     addrReg  := io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr
     ```
   
   - **CSR passthrough address bits** (lines 113-124): Only forwards `id`, `addr`, `len`, `size`, `burst` to csrAxi

3. **What AxiSlave does**: It routes AXI transactions based on address decoding (ITCM/DTCM/CSR regions) and only extracts the transaction ID and address for routing logic. It completely ignores protection, lock, cache, QoS, and region attributes.
